title: Giri Babu, Telugu actor of more than 600 films, dies at 80
dek: The actor, director and producer, who moved from lead roles to villains and comic parts over five decades, died in a Hyderabad hospital on Saturday.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Giri Babu, the veteran Telugu actor, director and producer who appeared in more than 600 films over five decades, died on Saturday at a private hospital in Kondapur, Hyderabad, according to reports. He was 80. His son, the actor Raghu Babu, said he had been suffering from Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and a lung infection for about three years, reports said.

Born Yerra Seshagiri Rao in Ravinuthala village in Prakasam district of Andhra Pradesh, he made his debut in Jagame Maya in 1973. He began as a leading man and became better known for villains, comic roles and character parts, working with stars from N T Rama Rao and Akkineni Nageswara Rao to Chiranjeevi and Nagarjuna. His films included Kurukshetram (1977), in which he played Dushasana, Hello Brother, Ninne Pelladata and, in recent years, Geetha Govindam and Jathi Ratnalu. He directed Ranarangam (1985), Indrajith (1990) and Nee Sukhame Ne Koruthunna (2008).

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu called his death a significant loss to Telugu cinema, and Chiranjeevi said the news was shocking, according to reports.

His wife, Sridevi, died in 2016. He is survived by his sons Raghu Babu and Bose Babu, who both work in films, and a daughter. Reports give different birth years, 1943 and 1946; most reports give his age as 80.
